oids.description: Gets the current of an outlet. (unit: 0.0001A)

oids.name: pBigPower
oids.description: Gets the power of an outlet. (unit: 0.001W)

oids.name: pBigApparentPower
oids.description: Gets the apparent power of an outlet. (unit: 0.001VA)

oids.name: pDetectedPhase
oids.description: Gives the best matching Phase per currentsensor. Updated every 8s. returnes 255 if no good phaselink is found

oids.name: pModuleName
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the module name.

oids.description: Gets the version of the module's firmware.

oids.description: Gets the ID of the module's firmware.

oids.name: pPortName
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the name of an outlet.

oids.name: pPortState
oids.description: Sets the state of an outlet: 0=OFF, 1=ON, 2=POWER CYCLE. To get the state of an outlet use CPORTSTAT (CLI) or pStatePortCur (SNMP) (GUID 8) instead.

oids.name: pCurrentPriorOff
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the priority of an outlet. Priority settings are used when 1 or more outlets must be turned off because the total current of a power module was exceeded.

oids.name: pDelayOn
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the outlet turn-on delay. Use this to reduce inrush current when the Energy Switch boots. (unit: s)

oids.name: pMaxCurrentOff
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum current off level of an outlet. (unit: 0.001A)

oids.name: pMaxCurrentWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum current warning level of an outlet. (unit: 0.001A)

oids.name: pMaxPowerOff
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum power off level of an outlet. (unit: W)

oids.name: pMaxPowerWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum power warning level of an outlet. (unit: W)

oids.name: pMaxTotalCurrentOff
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the total maximum current off level of a power module. (unit: 0.001A)

oids.name: pMaxTotalCurrentWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the total maximum current warning level of a power module. (unit: 0.001A)

oids.name: pMaxTotalPowerOff
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum total power off level. (unit: W)

oids.name: pMaxTotalPowerWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum total power warning level. (unit: W)

oids.name: pMaxVoltageWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum voltage warning level. (unit: 0.01V)

oids.name: pMinVoltageWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the minimum voltage warning level. (unit: 0.01V)

oids.name: pMinTemperatureWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the minimum temperature warning level (use DEF accessor to reset). (unit: 0.1K)

oids.name: pMaxTemperatureWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum temperature warning level (use DEF accessor to reset). (unit: 0.1K)

oids.name: pPortStateEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the state of an outlet is changed.

oids.name: pCurrentOffEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the outlet current off level is exceeded.

oids.name: pCurrentWarningEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the outlet current warning level is exceeded.

oids.name: pPowerOffEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the power off level is exceeded.

oids.name: pPowerWarningEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the power warning level is exceeded.

oids.name: pTotalCurrentOffEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the total outlet current off level is exceeded.

oids.name: pTotalCurrentWarningEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the total outlet current warning level is exceeded.

oids.name: pTotalPowerOffEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the total power off level is exceeded.

oids.name: pTotalPowerWarningEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the total power warning level is exceeded.

oids.name: pVoltageWarningEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the voltage warning level is exceeded.

oids.name: pTemperatureWarningEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the temperature warning level is exceeded.

oids.name: pMaxOverheatingOff
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum overheat temperature off level. (unit: 0.1K)

oids.name: pOverheatingOffEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the overtemperature off level is exceeded.

oids.name: pPowerCycleTime
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the time interval that is used to do a power cycle of an outlet. (unit: s)

oids.name: pExternalSensorLabel
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the external sensor label. External sensors can be connected to Energy Sensors.

oids.name: pMaxOverheatingWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the overheating temperature warning level. (unit: 0.1K)

oids.name: pOverheatingWarningEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if the overheat warning level is exceeded.

oids.name: pMicroIntTimeThreshold
oids.description: The minimum time the voltage must be interrupted before it is seen as a micro interruption (unit: 0.1ms)

oids.name: pMicroIntEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if a microinterruption on the voltage is detected.

oids.name: pSoftFuseCurrentThreshold
oids.description: The threshold of the soft fuse is a factor of the maximum nominal current off (unit: A)

oids.name: pSoftFuseDelay
oids.description: The minimum time the current of an outlet must be above the soft fuse current threshold to switch it off. (unit: ms)

oids.name: pSoftFuseEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if a soft fuse is triggered.

oids.name: pPhaseShiftEvent
oids.description: Enables or disables the SNMP trap if a phase shift on the voltage is detected.

oids.name: pSchedulePortOnTime
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the time for the scheduler to turn on an outlet. (unit: min)

oids.name: pSchedulePortOffTime
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the time for the scheduler to turn off an outlet. (unit: min)

oids.name: pEnableSchedulePort
oids.description: Enables or disables the scheduler on an outlet. When enabled the scheduling is repeated daily.

oids.name: pBlockSetPortOff
oids.description: Prevent outlets to be set off (only delay on and powercycle are still possible).

oids.name: pSchedulePortChangeEvent
oids.description: event if a port has changed state because of the scheduler

oids.name: pAgentIP
oids.description: IP address of the agent associated to this outlet

oids.name: pAgentPort
oids.description: Network port on which the associated agent will listen

oids.name: pAgentCommunicationEventFlags
oids.description: Event flags for events related to agent communication

oids.name: pAlwaysOn
oids.description: Outlets marked as Always On can only be power cycled by the user

oids.name: pGenericTransducerParameters
oids.description: sets the slope of the transducer transfer function when the generic transducer type is selected (unit: mA/V)

oids.name: pMaxBigCurrentWarning

oids.name: pMaxBigPowerWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the maximum power warning level of an outlet. (unit: 0.001W)

oids.name: pGroupNumber
oids.description: Group number per port to group ports

oids.name: pPhaseLink
oids.description: Link the current port with a voltage phase

oids.name: pCurrentSensorSelector
oids.description: Selection of the currentsensor connected to port. To enter your own value you need to use 255 and fill in guid 10190.

oids.name: pMinBigCurrentWarning
oids.description: Gets, sets or defaults the minimum current warning level of a port. (unit: 0.0001A)
